endpoint.text: Therefore, we assessed the TBP effect and mechanism on DSS-induced colitis mice.
Then, we measured the activity of DAO, SOD, and GSH-PX in colon tissue homogenate using a kit.
Subsequently, we evaluated the degree of edema, superficial necrosis, and infiltration of granulocytes in colon tissues.
